[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Art Institute of Chicago has an incredible collection of over 300,000 works of art.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-see exhibits at the Art Institute include Impressionist and Post-Impressionist Art, American Art, Modern and Contemporary Art, and Ancient and Byzantine Art.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Must-see pieces at the Art Institute include "American Gothic" by Grant Wood, "Nighthawks" by Edward Hopper, "A Sunday on La Grande Jatte" by Georges Seurat, "Water Lilies" by Claude Monet, and "The Old Guitarist" by Pablo Picasso.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Lakefront Trail is easily accessible from the Riverwalk area, with entry points near the Vietnam Veterans Memorial Plaza.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Lakefront Trail runs for about 18.5 miles and is perfect for walking, jogging, or biking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Millennium Park is located near the Lakefront Trail and features landmarks like the "Cloud Gate" sculpture (The Bean) and the Jay Pritzker Pavilion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Intelligentsia Coffee has a location at 53 E. Randolph St, which is about a 5-10 minute walk from the Lakefront Trail.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Millennium Park cafe of Intelligentsia Coffee offers a variety of specialty drinks, pastries, sandwiches, and salads.
